input.subject: Fwd: Re: Board package timing for the Whitman?
input.bodyText:
Ryan - forwarding the thread below so you have the full context. Bottom line, the managing agent says the board only meets monthly and the next meeting is the 19th, so if your buyer wants to close before Labor Day we need the package in by the 5th. Can your side turn the financials around that fast?

Gwen
